{{Quote|Yes. He’s expecting you.|Bidor Ferrouz's receptionist to Vestin Axlon|<ref name="COO" />}}
'''Bidor Ferrouz's receptionist''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served [[Bidor Ferrouz]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Poln Major]] in the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. She admitted the visiting [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Vestin Axlon]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], an Imperial agent pretending to be Axlon's assistant, into Ferrouz's office in the [[Whitestone City palace]] by pressing a door-release control underneath her desk. During a riot instigated by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], she was [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with two guards when [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] attacked Ferrouz's office.
